question: What transcendent and universal nature is attributed to the power being contemplated?
premises: The contemplated power has a radiance beyond the senses.
Her nature is identified with the self of all worlds.
Both attributes describe the same power.
inference: Therefore, the power is to be contemplated as having a radiance beyond the senses and as the very nature of the self of all worlds.
plain_english: One should contemplate her as having a radiance beyond the senses and as the very nature of the self of all worlds.
